# AI Daily Digest

> Every morning at 9:00 AM Eastern Time, a roundup of the previous day's AI news, trending AI projects on GitHub, and new AI products.

AI Daily Digest is a free daily newsletter and website published by SweetAI.
A new issue is published every morning at 9:00 AM Eastern Time and covers the
previous day's most important AI news stories, trending AI projects on GitHub,
and newly launched AI products. Each story links to its original source.
Sponsorship and advertising inquiries: contact@sweetai.work (see the sponsor page).

## Key pages

- [Latest issue](https://ai-daily-news.sweetai.work/): today's AI digest
- [Archive](https://ai-daily-news.sweetai.work/archive): every past issue, grouped by month and topic
- [Sponsor](https://ai-daily-news.sweetai.work/sponsor): sponsorship placements and rates on request
- [RSS feed](https://ai-daily-news.sweetai.work/feed.xml): full issue feed
